get_mask_pallete_visualize_mask: get a color palette image from a numpy mask array for PASCAL VOC, ADE20K, or Cityscapes datasets
get_mask_pallete_ade20k: get a color palette image from a numpy mask array using the ADE20K dataset palette
get_mask_pallete_cityscapes: get a color palette image from a numpy mask array using the Cityscapes dataset palette
get_voc_pallete_generate: generate a VOC-style color palette list for a given number of segmentation classes
review_pallete_module: review the palette module containing VOC, ADE20K, and Cityscapes color palettes for segmentation mask visualization
